admission.justification: Typed optional homes in document.py and fixed placements in readerTop.tsx and taskReader.tsx prevent recurring non-goal and acceptance text from being present only in arbitrary, unrendered prose sections.

applicability: Typed nonGoals and acceptance Markdown fields and their fixed dashboard placements on ordinary masters and tasks.
conditions: Non-goals follows Objective; Acceptance follows Design; absent or empty content does not require a heading.
exclusions: Adding these fixed blocks to sprint pages.
Migrating historical free-form text into the fields.

evidence: Parent examination of actual F01 changed extents; no new execution or acceptance.

statement: Masters and tasks expose optional Markdown nonGoals and acceptance fields at fixed page positions after Objective and Design respectively.
